name: mcpgawk
description: Measure the MCP servers your agent calls, record the tool surface you approved, and refuse a changed tool until a person has looked. Local-first.

interface.shortDescription: Know what your MCP servers can do, and be told when they change.
interface.longDescription: mcpgawk measures every MCP server your agent can reach, records the tool surface you approved, reports any change after that, and with the guard installed refuses a changed tool before the call runs. Approval stays with the person at the keyboard. Nothing is uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Check what this MCP server can do before I add it.
What can my MCP servers do and what do they cost?
Did any of my MCP servers change since I approved them?
